role: Test helper shared by the web-API client tests: an actor that answers every request with one canned status, body and headers and records the requests it was sent, exposing itself as an HTTPTransport.
types: StubHTTPTransport: actor — canned-reply HTTP transport that records requests

units.does: Stores the canned reply: status (default 200), body and headers (default none).
units.entry: Called by OverpassClientTests, MetNorwayForecastTests, TopoElevationServiceTests and WebSearchServiceTests.

units.does: Returns an HTTPTransport whose send hops onto the actor and calls respond(to:).
units.entry: Read by the tests that construct a client under test.

units.does: Appends the request to `requests`, then returns (body, HTTPURLResponse for the request's URL with the canned status and headers); throws URLError(.badURL) when the request has no URL or the response cannot be built.
units.entry: Called by the send closure of `transport` when the client under test sends.

branches.effect: return the canned reply; otherwise throw URLError(.badURL)
